description: This Java class 'WriterBuilder' provides static methods to create Cassandra SSTable writers for different tables related to 'thingsboard' key-value data, including schemas and insert statements.

classes.name: WriterBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for constructing Cassandra SSTable writers for specific 'thingsboard' tables.

methods.name: getTsWriter
methods.description: Creates a Cassandra SSTable writer for the 'ts_kv_cf' table in the specified directory.

methods.name: getLatestWriter
methods.description: Creates a Cassandra SSTable writer for the 'ts_kv_latest_cf' table in the specified directory.

methods.name: getPartitionWriter
methods.description: Creates a Cassandra SSTable writer for the 'ts_kv_partitions_cf' table in the specified directory.
